map.镜头视角（本页代码口径）：水平视角=2×arctan(传感器宽÷(2×焦距))×: Lens angle of view (this page's code basis): horizontal view = 2×arctan(sensor width÷(2×focal length))×180÷π (°); vertical view uses the same formula with the sensor height; diagonal view = 2×arctan(√(width²+height²)÷(2×focal length))×180÷π (°), all to 2 decimals. Validation: empty focal length or sensor width/height prompts and stops; when the focal length is 0, Infinity falls back in the result layer. Criteria: no fixed grading; a longer focal length narrows the view and a larger sensor widens it.
